decisions.reason: As a newly launched naval lighting line in a specialist, certification-heavy niche that fits the firm's robust industrial portfolio, it is unlikely to be withdrawn so quickly.
The spring-balanced desk lamp fits the firm's ergonomic workplace offer, though as a smaller standalone product line it is somewhat less core than integrated building lighting.
A newly arrived general interior luminaire with its own page aligns closely with the firm's mainstream building-lighting business and should stay in the range.
Because this pendant luminaire was presented as a flagship direction product, management would be very unlikely to remove it within a year of launch.
The marine HMI searchlight serves a specialist market the firm knows, but HMI technology is less aligned with the company's LED- and sustainability-led direction, raising discontinuation risk.
The marine searchlight remains consistent with the firm's demanding-environment and transport-related offer, so it is more likely to be retained than cut.
